name: Timbre
author: Erin Carter
description: A vast tam-tam nearly fills the frame: a hammered bronze disc a half-step above the void. Its brightness is the analytic sum of five fixed inharmonic partials — radial cosines at irrational wavenumber ratios times low-order angular factors at hashed orientations — so the antinode pattern is a mottled shimmer and its zero web an irregular lace of dark lines that never moves within a ring-down. Each partial owns a tint; near-ratio partials beat slowly against one another, regions waxing and waning while nothing travels. A hash-scheduled strike releases the full-spectrum shimmer and the partials decay at different rates, the fine mottle dissolving into the broad slow lobes of the fundamental, with occasional half-strength after-touches re-exciting only the lower partials.

params.label: Strike gap
params.effect: Mean seconds between full strikes of the gong, with hashed after-touches scattered between.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: Overall sustain; long values let the coarsening from shimmer to slow lobes play out fully.

params.label: Shimmer
params.effect: Level of the upper partials, from a dark fundamental swell to a bright crashing sparkle.

params.label: Beat rate
params.effect: Detune between near-ratio partials, setting how fast regions of the gong wax and wane against each other; zero stills the beating entirely.
